versions.changelog:
- Initial release of self-hosted-funnel-launch skill.
- Guides users through deploying a self-hosted sales funnel using Autonnel.
- Supports Cloudflare Workers (free-tier, production-ready), Docker (local evaluation or BYO server), and Node source checkout.
- Includes instructions for connecting Postgres, handling secrets, running CLI/admin commands, and understanding key Cloudflare free-plan limits.
- Describes typical use cases: self-hosted ClickFunnels alternative, infrastructure control, and agent-driven funnel creation/deployment.
